plan_requirement: Section10.4: same actual Host request, available sources and initial before; strong fixed/rules, Jev and generative controllers share the operation library.

collection.boundary: At entry to an actual schema-valid milai_retrieve call, before the started retrieval row and known-reference reads. Preserve literal request, call_id, bound public turn, source namespace and original read/generation allowances.
collection.artifact: call.json plus before/: root configuration/index, selected bank files, SQLite online backups of Store/checkpoints/application SQLite files. Raw Host prefix trace path retained. Other banks are outside this request.
collection.concurrency: Opt-in collection sets tool executor max_concurrency=1. Verified with two native calls in one scripted Host response; each next snapshot retains prior consumed allowance.
collection.failures: Original tool failures and zero-decision calls retained. No ideal-request filtering. Schema-rejected attempts have no tool-entry snapshot: future cohort assembly must reconcile original Host traces and report these separately, never silently treat captures as all Host attempts.
collection.cached_calls: Cached/idempotent tool re-entries are also captured; they retain the existing receipt and have no new policy decision. Native Host duplicate call IDs remain rejected by the unchanged provider boundary.

execution.recipe: List of named arms, each with a policy config for existing memory_policy. Full captured cohort, fresh runtime copy per arm/call, common warm native-model pool, original external ledger.
execution.request: Invoke actual registered tool using original call_id and original public-message identity. No Host request regeneration or answer repair.
execution.common_runtime: Original execution caps, source/view capacity, visibility, Store, read admission and generation admission. Only executor configuration is an explicit factor recorded separately from original input-freeze.
execution.admission: Restore original read-admission policy identity because previous calls consumed that allowance under the original executor. Only memory_control class may differ; every other admission field must match. Prior calls and counters are not reset or rewritten. Default path retains its original policy check.
execution.initial_observation: Compare reconstructed semantic observation to captured first before. Reuse captured source_inventory_wall_seconds in the first model observation; record newly measured inventory wall separately. Then require exact complete before and action equality. Later trajectories are free to differ.
execution.zero_decisions: Retain original zero-step/exhausted cases with null initial observation; request/binding/allowance still checked.
execution.failure: First failed comparison retained with artifacts; CLI stops for review, no automatic retry. Existing closed original results cannot replace a new arm execution.

accounting.capture: Measured snapshot CPU/wall is nested collection overhead, recorded in call.json, not double billed.
accounting.replay: replay.json separates actual ledger compute from remaining CPU. CLI driver adds outer orchestration CPU; total driver CPU is nested.
accounting.validation: All current checks use isolated temporary mock ledgers and scripted HTTP/native models. No actual model job or original-ledger settlement added while PID2670549 runs. Untimed author/tests/commands are not zero.
